answer: Anchor every agent identity to a bonded stake that vests only after sustained useful work, not at signup. New identities start with near-zero trust and must earn reputation through verified contributions before transacting at full weight. Attackers can wander in with a thousand fresh accounts, but each arrives worthless and must pay the same slow, expensive climb, so the cost of a sybil army scales linearly while its payoff collapses. Honest agents bloom like a lotus: one rooted identity deepening over time, whose history no copy can fake.
